cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
from databricks.sdk.service.catalog import VolumeType
w = WorkspaceClient()
cat, sch = 'workspace','mlpabb3a670'
# create volume
try:
    v = w.volumes.create(catalog_name=cat, schema_name=sch, name='model_artifacts', volume_type=VolumeType.MANAGED)
    print('volume:', v.full_name)
except Exception as e:
    print('vol err:', str(e)[:200])
# upload artifact
import io
with open('data/model.json','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
path=f'/Volumes/{cat}/{sch}/model_artifacts/churnmodel7948d0/model.json'
w.files.upload(path, io.BytesIO(data), overwrite=True)
print('uploaded to', path)
print(w.files.get_metadata(path))
"
tool_input.description: Create volume and upload model artifact

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
w = WorkspaceClient()
user='benedict@logicalclocks.com'
exp_path=f'/Users/{user}/mlpabb3a670/churn_exp'
import json
metrics=json.load(open('data/metrics.json'))
try:
    exp_id=w.experiments.create_experiment(name=exp_path).experiment_id
except Exception as e:
    print('exp err', str(e)[:200])
    exp_id=w.experiments.get_by_name(exp_path).experiment.experiment_id
print('exp_id',exp_id)
run=w.experiments.create_run(experiment_id=exp_id, run_name='churn_run').run
run_id=run.info.run_id
print('run_id',run_id)
from databricks.sdk.service.ml import Metric
mets=[Metric(key=k, value=float(v), timestamp=0, step=0) for k,v in metrics.items()]
w.experiments.log_batch(run_id=run_id, metrics=mets)
w.experiments.update_run(run_id=run_id, status='FINISHED')
r=w.experiments.get_run(run_id=run_id).run
print('logged metrics:', [(m.key,m.value) for m in (r.data.metrics or [])])
" 2>&1 | head -40

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
import json
w = WorkspaceClient()
full='workspace.mlpabb3a670.churnmodel7948d0'
metrics=json.load(open('data/metrics.json'))
# set tags with metric values for robust readback
for k,v in metrics.items():
    w.api_client.do('POST','/api/2.0/mlflow/unity-catalog/model-versions/set-tag',
        body={'full_name':full,'version':'1','key':k,'value':str(v)})
mv=w.model_versions.get(full_name=full, version=1)
print('version:',mv.version,'status:',mv.status,'run_id:',mv.run_id)
print('source:',mv.source)
print('tags:', [(t.key,t.value) for t in (mv.aliases or [])] )
# fetch full via REST to see tags
r=w.api_client.do('GET','/api/2.0/mlflow/unity-catalog/model-versions/get',
    query={'full_name':full,'version':'1'})
print('REST mv tags:', r['model_version'].get('tags'))
print('REST status:', r['model_version'].get('status'))
"
tool_input.description: Verify model version and set metric tags
